summary_en: This study tests CAN1012, a TLR7 agonist, injected into the lesion in people with ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) or lobular carcinoma in situ (LCIS). CAN1012 is given as a single injection directly into the target lesion on Day 0, before surgery, and the record does not state any further dosing schedule. The record does not list a primary outcome; it says tissue from standard surgery will be checked for immune changes compared with baseline on several days, and the study is Phase I/Ib.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa CAN1012, un agonista de TLR7, inyectado en la lesión en personas con carcinoma ductal in situ (DCIS) o carcinoma lobulillar in situ (LCIS). CAN1012 se administra como una sola inyección directamente en la lesión objetivo el Día 0, antes de la cirugía, y el registro no indica otro esquema de dosis. El registro no enumera un desenlace principal; señala que el tejido de la cirugía estándar será evaluado para detectar cambios inmunológicos comparados con el basal en varios días, y el estudio es de Fase I/Ib.
who_for: Adults 18 or older who can give consent and follow the protocol.
DCIS or LCIS found on core biopsy.
A single lesion 1 to 5 cm by imaging, with no invasive disease on biopsy and no suspicious ipsilateral lymph nodes on ultrasound.
Lab values within 72 hours of Day 0 that meet set limits; people able to conceive must use non-hormonal contraception.
not_for: Serious underlying medical or psychiatric condition that the investigator judges a safety risk.
Need for corticosteroids of 10 mg or more prednisone daily equivalent (inhaled steroids allowed).
Need for hormonal contraception or medicines that are sensitive substrates of major CYP enzymes.
Active or significant autoimmune disease, prior bone marrow transplant, or prior oral GVHD.
Active infection needing systemic therapy, or active or uncontrolled hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV with AIDS.
